The integration of these targets highlights a possible role for doxorubicin in modulating the activity of COLO-800 via receptor-mediated pathways, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction between doxorubicin and COLO-800.
